column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV adds “A Psalm,” and רִיבָה (“contend”) is rendered “Plead my cause.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְצִנָּה (“large shield”) is rendered “buckler.”
NKJV takes וּסְגֹר (“and battle-axe/close”) as a verb, “And stop those who pursue me.”
Close to the Hebrew; דּוֹחֶה (“driving”) is rendered “chase them.”
Close to the Hebrew; נֵכִים (“smiters”) is rendered “Attackers.”
The Hebrew is obscure (“godless mockers of a cake”); NKJV renders “ungodly mockers at feasts.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my only one” is rendered “My precious life,” and “young lions” “the lions.”
Close to the Hebrew; שֶׁקֶר (“falsely”) is rendered “wrongfully.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Aha, our desire!” is rendered “Ah, so we would have it!”
Close to the Hebrew; “those who delight in my righteousness” is rendered “Who favor my righteous cause,” and “welfare” “prosperity.”
